source_note: Labour Code of the Republic of Armenia ՀՕ-124-Ն (arlis.am redaction 23.12.2022-06.04.2023; owner confirmed current 22 Nov 2026). Quotes and article reading in docs/legal/PRE_REVIEW.md. Lawyer must confirm.
basis: Art. 92(1): probation cannot exceed three months; Art. 92(2): up to six months in cases provided by legislation (PRE_REVIEW 1.9; the earlier 12 months had no source).
edge_cases: Special case = 6 months (Art. 92(2)), not 12; another act may allow more for specific posts (no source supplied).
Art. 92(3): sick leave, agreed or unpaid leave, public duties, strikes are not counted in the term, so the real end date can be later than start + N months; the rule uses the recorded end date.
Last allowed day = start + N months - 1 day is not stated in the Code (Art. 29 on counting terms: lawyer to confirm).
Month-end starts clamp (31 Jan + 3 months = 30 Apr).
Other no-probation cases (Art. 91(3)(2),(4)) not modelled yet.
